fields.label: Population ID
fields.definition: Unique local population identifier.

fields.label: Population Name
fields.definition: Source-supported group/cohort/subgroup label.

fields.label: Population Definition
fields.definition: Member eligibility and relevant randomized/evaluable/analysis context; distinguish members from method.
fields.example: Eligibility and analysis-set definition reported for the selected study.

fields.label: Population Size
fields.definition: Reported member count, not an assumed endpoint denominator or model sample size.

fields.label: Intervention
fields.definition: Drug/device/behavioral intervention or comparison actually assigned/received.

fields.label: Intervention Regimen
fields.definition: Dose, route, frequency, duration and common care needed to interpret comparison.
fields.example: Reported dose, route, frequency and duration.

fields.label: Population Time Frame
fields.definition: Recruitment/treatment/follow-up periods defining population; each result has its own assessment time.

fields.label: Measure ID
fields.definition: Unique local measure identifier.

fields.label: Measure Name
fields.definition: Clinical quantity or criterion; a statistical summary is not a separate measure.

fields.label: Measure Definition
fields.definition: Instrument, response criterion, assessment basis and supported scale needed to distinguish measures.

fields.label: Result ID
fields.definition: Unique local principal-statistic identifier.

fields.label: Population ID
fields.definition: Submitted population for this result; do not infer endpoint/model n.

fields.label: Measure ID
fields.definition: Submitted measure actually quantified.

fields.label: Assessment Time
fields.definition: Assessment point or change interval anchored to correct reference.

fields.label: Statistic Type
fields.definition: Reported principal statistic: mean, count, difference, HR, ES etc. Never infer unspecified ES formula.

fields.label: Statistical Method
fields.definition: Reported method, adjustment, missing-data handling and analysis version; state relevant missing details.

fields.label: Result Value
fields.definition: Source principal value or compact count/category summary; retain precision, inequalities, NR/NE. Do not calculate absent statistics.

fields.label: Unit
fields.definition: Source-supported unit/scale; do not assign score points to unspecified ES.

fields.label: Comparison
fields.definition: Actual submitted population IDs and explicit formula/direction; state when unreported. Null for ordinary arm summaries.

fields.label: Supplementary Statistics
fields.definition: Own CI (level/bounds), SD/SE, P, percentage and applicable denominator with meaning; never copy population totals to unreported endpoint/model n.

fields.label: Population A ID
fields.definition: First submitted population.

fields.label: Relationship
fields.definition: Direct source-supported membership relation. subset of is directional; disjoint from and overlaps with are symmetric.

fields.label: Population B ID
fields.definition: Second population; parent for subset of.
